items.source: exceptionType - the exception type associated with the problem
items.translation: exceptionType - 与问题关联的异常类型

items.source: Use the given MessageSource to resolve the type, title, and detail message codes, and then use the resolved values to update the corresponding fields in getBody().
items.translation: 使用给定的MessageSource解析type、title和detail消息代码，然后使用解析后的值更新getBody()中的相应字段。

items.source: Variant of builder(Throwable, HttpStatusCode, String) for use with a custom ProblemDetail instance.
items.translation: 用于自定义ProblemDetail实例的builder(Throwable, HttpStatusCode, String)变体。

items.source: Static factory method to build an instance via builder(Throwable, HttpStatusCode, String).
items.translation: 通过 builder(Throwable, HttpStatusCode, String) 静态工厂方法构建实例。

items.source: messageSource - the MessageSource to use for the lookup
items.translation: messageSource - 用于查找的 MessageSource

items.source: ErrorResponse is supported as a return value from @ExceptionHandler methods that render directly to the response, for example, by being marked @ResponseBody, or declared in an @RestController or RestControllerAdvice class.
items.translation: `ErrorResponse` 支持作为从直接渲染到响应的 `@ExceptionHandler` 方法的返回值，例如，通过标记为 `@ResponseBody`，或在 `@RestController` 或 `RestControllerAdvice` 类中声明。

items.source: Note: The returned ProblemDetail may be updated before the response is rendered, for example, via updateAndGetBody(MessageSource, Locale). Therefore, implementing methods should use an instance field, and should not re-create the ProblemDetail on every call, nor use a static variable.
items.translation: 注意： 返回的 ProblemDetail 可能在响应渲染之前被更新，例如通过updateAndGetBody(MessageSource, Locale)。因此，实现方法应使用实例字段，不应在每次调用时重新创建 ProblemDetail，也不应使用静态变量。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to getDetailMessageArguments(), ignoring the supplied MessageSource and Locale.
items.translation: 默认实现委托给getDetailMessageArguments()，忽略提供的MessageSource和Locale。

items.source: ErrorResponseException is a default implementation of this interface and a convenient base class for other exceptions to use.
items.translation: ErrorResponseException 是该接口的默认实现，也是其他异常使用的便捷基类。

items.source: By default this is initialized via getDefaultTypeMessageCode(Class).
items.translation: 默认情况下，这通过getDefaultTypeMessageCode(Class)进行初始化。

items.source: By default this is initialized via getDefaultTitleMessageCode(Class).
items.translation: 默认情况下，这通过getDefaultTitleMessageCode(Class)进行初始化。

items.source: By default this is initialized via getDefaultDetailMessageCode(Class, String).
items.translation: 默认情况下，这通过 getDefaultDetailMessageCode(Class, String) 初始化。

items.source: This is useful for example to expand message codes from validation errors.
items.translation: 这对于例如从验证错误中扩展消息代码很有用。

items.source: Return the body for the response, formatted as an RFC 9457 ProblemDetail whose status should match the response status.
items.translation: 返回一个响应体，格式为 RFC 9457ProblemDetail，其status应与响应状态匹配。

items.source: Return arguments to use along with a message code to resolve the problem "detail" for this exception through a MessageSource.
items.translation: 返回要与message code一起使用的参数，以便通过MessageSource解析此异常的“detail”问题。

items.source: Variant of getDetailMessageArguments() that uses the given MessageSource for resolving the message argument values.
items.translation: `getDetailMessageArguments()` 的变体，使用给定的 MessageSource 解析消息参数值。

items.source: Return arguments to use along with a message code to resolve the problem "detail" for this exception through a MessageSource. The arguments are expanded into placeholders of the message value, for example, "Invalid content type {0}".
items.translation: 返回参数，与message code一起使用，通过一个MessageSource解析此异常的“detail”问题。这些参数被扩展为消息值的占位符，例如，“Invalid content type {0}"。

items.source: Return a code to use to resolve the problem "detail" for this exception through a MessageSource.
items.translation: 返回一个用于通过 `MessageSource` 解决此异常中的 "detail" 问题的代码。

items.source: Return a code to use to resolve the problem "title" for this exception through a MessageSource.
items.translation: 返回一个用于通过 `MessageSource` 解决此异常的 "title" 问题的代码。

items.source: Return a code to use to resolve the problem "type" for this exception through a MessageSource.
items.translation: 通过一个MessageSource返回用于解决此异常的"type"的代码。

items.source: Return a builder to create an ErrorResponse instance.
items.translation: 返回一个用于创建 ErrorResponse 实例的构建器。

items.source: Build a message code for the "detail" field, for the given exception type.
items.translation: 为给定的异常类型构建“detail”字段的错误代码。

items.source: Build a message code for the "title" field, for the given exception type.
items.translation: 为给定的异常类型构建"title"字段的消息代码。

items.source: Build a message code for the "type" field, for the given exception type.
items.translation: 为给定的异常类型构建“type”字段的消息代码。

items.source: Return headers to use for the response.
items.translation: 返回用于响应的标头。

items.source: Return the HTTP status code to use for the response.
items.translation: 返回用于响应的 HTTP 状态码。

items.source: detail - the default value for the detail field, unless overridden by a MessageSource lookup with getDetailMessageCode()
items.translation: detail - 除非被带有getDetailMessageCode()的MessageSource查找所覆盖，否则为detail字段的默认值。

items.source: "problemDetail.type." followed by the fully qualified class name
items.translation: `problemDetail.type.` 后跟完全限定类名

items.source: "problemDetail.title." followed by the fully qualified class name
items.translation: `problemDetail.title.` 后跟完全限定类名

items.source: "problemDetail." followed by the fully qualified class name and an optional suffix
items.translation: `"problemDetail."` 后跟完全限定类名和一个可选的后缀

items.source: ex - the underlying exception that lead to the error response; mainly to derive default values for the detail message code and for the title message code.
items.translation: ex - 导致错误响应的底层异常；主要用于推导详细信息消息代码和标题消息代码的默认值。

items.source: locale - the Locale to use for the lookup
items.translation: locale - 用于查找的 Locale

items.source: suffix - an optional suffix, for example, for exceptions that may have multiple error message with different arguments
items.translation: suffix - 一个可选后缀，例如用于可能具有多个带有不同参数的错误消息的异常。

items.source: statusCode - the status code to set in the response
items.translation: statusCode - 要在响应中设置的状态码

items.source: Callback to perform an action before an RFC-9457 ProblemDetail response is rendered.
items.translation: 在渲染 RFC-9457 ProblemDetail 响应之前执行操作的回调。

items.source: Builder for an ErrorResponse.
items.translation: 用于构建ErrorResponse的 Builder。

items.source: Rossen Stoyanchev
items.translation: Rossen Stoyanchev

items.translation: 嵌套类摘要
